newsitem.title: UK: Ramco makes agreed 54 mln st bid for JKX.
newsitem.headline: Ramco makes agreed 54 mln st bid for JKX.

text.p: Oil exploration company Ramco Energy Plc on Wednesday said it would make an agreed 54.0 million pound ($90.7 million) bid for JKX Oil & Gas Plc.
Both companies are active in the former Soviet Union.
Ramco will offer one new Ramco share for every 25 JKX shares, valueing each JKX share at 46.3 pence per share.
Ramco, which is mainly active in Azerbaijan, said the JKX bid fits its strategy of focusing on opportunities in the former Soviet Union and Eastern Europe.
JKX primarily operates in Ukraine through a gas producer called Poltava Petroleum Company, in which JKX has a 49 percent stake.
"The combination of Ramco and JKX will establish an enlarged group which should be better placed to enhance the value in JKX's existing asset portfolio," said JKX chairman Sir Robert Horton.
Ramco secured several highly rated deals in Azerbaijan and saw its shares rise sharply in the past year.
In contrast, JKX shares have fallen steeply as the company lost an important customer while many other potential clients don't have the money to pay their gas bills. ($ = 0.595 British Pounds)
